title: rhodiola rosea subsp. integrifolia
intro: Rhodiola rosea subsp. integrifolia, commonly known as Arctic rhodiola, is a plant species within the Rhodiola genus, specifically a subspecies of Rhodiola rosea. It is used in traditional medicine for its adaptogenic properties, which contribute to its various health benefits, including improved mental clarity, reduced stress levels, and enhanced mood stability. The therapeutic actions of Rhodiola rosea subsp. integrifolia are attributed to its adaptogenic and antioxidant effects, which help in mitigating the negative effects of stress and promoting overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include rosavin, rosin, and salidroside, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties and are often used in dietary supplements.
